body:
_Migrated from issue #1369, filed 2026-08-04._

Found while running the full unit suite for #1368. It is not that PR — the failure reproduces on a clean tree with the branch stashed.

```
FAILED tests/unit/test_ingest_batch_dirty.py::test_successful_import_marks_batch_dirty_without_hot_loop_http_calls
1 failed, 2 passed
```

The other 5078 tests pass. Worth tracing before it gets normalised as background noise: a red test on `main` that nobody attributes stops being a signal, and this one guards the ingest batch-dirty path against a hot loop of HTTP calls — a regression there is expensive and quiet.

Note the Fast Tests CI job runs with `--maxfail`, so a failure early in the ordering can hide others behind it; check the full list, not the first entry.
title: test_ingest_batch_dirty fails on a clean main
